title: Grade 2 French — Tue, Jun 10
description: Les animaux — Day 2 of 5: Wild animals vocabulary
subject: french

questions.question: What is 'un lion' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Un lion' = a lion. 'Le lion est le roi de la jungle.' = The lion is the king of the jungle.

questions.question: How do you say 'an elephant' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Un éléphant' = an elephant. 'L'éléphant est très grand.' = The elephant is very big.

questions.question: What is 'un tigre' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Un tigre' = a tiger. 'Le tigre est l'animal national de l'Inde.' = The tiger is India's national animal.

questions.question: How do you say 'a giraffe' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Une girafe' = a giraffe. 'La girafe a un long cou.' = The giraffe has a long neck.

questions.question: What is 'un serpent' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Un serpent' = a snake. 'Le serpent rampe.' = The snake slithers.

questions.question: What is 'un singe' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Un singe' = a monkey. 'Le singe grimpe aux arbres.' = The monkey climbs trees.

questions.question: How do you say 'a zebra' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Un zèbre' = a zebra. 'Le zèbre a des rayures noires et blanches.' = The zebra has black and white stripes.

questions.question: What is 'un ours' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Un ours' = a bear. 'L'ours brun vit dans la forêt.' = The brown bear lives in the forest.

questions.question: Where do wild animals (animaux sauvages) live?
options: Dans la forêt ou la savane (in the forest or savanna)
questions.explanation: 'Les animaux sauvages vivent dans la forêt ou la savane.' = Wild animals live in the forest or savanna.

questions.question: How do you say 'a crocodile' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Un crocodile' = a crocodile. 'Le crocodile vit dans les rivières.' = The crocodile lives in rivers.

questions.question: What is 'un loup' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Un loup' = a wolf. 'Le loup hurle la nuit.' = The wolf howls at night.

questions.question: Complete: 'Le ___ a des rayures.' (The tiger has stripes.)
questions.explanation: 'Le tigre a des rayures.' = The tiger has stripes. 'Des rayures' = stripes.

questions.question: Which animal is 'le roi de la jungle' (king of the jungle)?
questions.explanation: 'Le lion est le roi de la jungle.' = The lion is the king of the jungle.

questions.question: What is the difference between 'animaux domestiques' and 'animaux sauvages'?
options: Domestiques = pets/farm animals (with humans); sauvages = wild animals (in nature)
questions.explanation: 'Animaux domestiques' = domestic/farm animals (chien, chat, vache); 'animaux sauvages' = wild animals (lion, éléphant, loup).

questions.question: How do you say 'I like elephants' in French?
questions.explanation: 'J'aime les éléphants.' = I like elephants. 'Aimer' = to like/love. Use 'les' (plural article) with the noun.
